description: Rebuild of build_supervisor_auto_updater which failed. Daemon that monitors for configuration drift in supervisord and corrects it. Must use write_service :8772 exclusively for state. Heartbeat to service_health at least every 60s. Parses supervisord_sentinel_full.conf for current config. Compares against expected state. Can trigger supervisorctl reload without restart. No direct duckdb import - all reads via write_service /query. Dependency declarations as top comment.
